answer: By the pulse of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The glacier holds work receipts rather than names, so the ember of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, re-queued for a second panel, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
